evidence: MINFIN Angola Precos Vigiados: national retail dessert banana 222-369 AOA/kg = 454-689 USD/t at the official rate 2019-23; export unit value 500-585 USD/t 2022-23 (IndexBox); World Bank Agriculture Support Policy Review 2021: farm gate ~ FOB less transport/processing, SCT 6% (2018) to 0.2% (2019). Farm gate supportable at 200-350 USD/t; the item-median basis fallback (432) is a retail-level number. Pin = midpoint 300.

Converted at 5.5-6:1 cherry to green (Coffee Ithaka; Fairtrade LIRP note), farm-gate evidence gives 2,000-5,500 USD/t green-equivalent at the official rate; conservative point 2,500-3,300 given a possible 7.9:1 out-turn for export-grade green. FOB unit values 3,309 (2019/20) to ~5,400 (2022/23), USDA GAIN ET2023-0014. Pin 2,900.
